label_rationale: mintedBy is incremented after the receiver hook, so a re-entrant mint passes the per-wallet check twice
mechanism: ERC721 mint pass with a per-wallet mint cap; safe mint calls onERC721Received
target_property: mintedBy[u] <= MAX_PER_WALLET for every address u
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['mintedBy', 'totalMinted']

ghost_state.name: pendingMint
ghost_state.meaning: token minted to the caller whose mintedBy increment is deferred

exposure_invariant.formula: mintedBy[caller] + pendingMint <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && totalMinted <= MAX_SUPPLY
exposure_invariant.stable_formula: mintedBy[caller] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && totalMinted <= MAX_SUPPLY

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for MintPass_TH01b
  target property phi : mintedBy[caller] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET
  exposure site       : mint.onERC721Received  (receiver hook (via _checkReceiver))
  ghost state         : uint256 pendingMint

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During mint's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['mint']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {mintedBy[caller] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && totalMinted <= MAX_SUPPLY} pre-phase {mintedBy[caller] + pendingMint <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && totalMinted <= MAX_SUPPLY}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = mintedBy[caller] + pendingMint <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && totalMinted <= MAX_SUPPLY)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_mint']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {mintedBy[caller] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && totalMinted <= MAX_SUPPLY /\ pendingMint==0}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => mintedBy[caller] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['mint'], depth-one

witness.explanation: the admissible callback mint is admitted by A_cb and drives I_exp to false during the exposed phase; replayed on the source model it violates mintedBy[caller] <= MAX_PER_WALLET && mintedBy[who] <= MAX_PER_WALLET
